_about: The Grid tool (/grid): every assumption its figures rest on, its default, its unit, its source and how to change it. The network's and the gravity shape's are the page's own code's (site/lib/); the carbon intensity's and the mix's are the warehouse's builders' (warehouse/derived/); the Ask panel's are its stored file's and the chats' (warehouse/chat/). replicate.py and replicate.do read the values marked so below; the others are rules the page follows, listed so a reader sees every choice. A change here changes the replication, not the page.

network_window_hours.source: warehouse/derived/grid_network.py: the snapshot holds the last week of EIA-930's hourly interchange (hours, links' mw arrays of 168)
network_window_hours.change: the window of grid_network.py and network_hourly.py; the page draws whatever the snapshot holds

network_snapshot.value: the hourly copy in public Storage, else the committed one
network_snapshot.source: site/lib/network.ts pickSnapshot: Storage's erw-public/network/grid_network.json when it is whole and its newest hour is not older than site/data/grid_network.json's

network_pair_rule.value: each pair once, read from the BA whose code sorts first
network_pair_rule.source: warehouse/derived/grid_network.py (the snapshot's rule): a pair's flow is the one the first BA in code order reported, positive when it exported

network_quiet_hours.source: site/lib/networkV3.ts completeHour, quiet = 48: a pair that held no flow in the snapshot's last 48 hours is silent and does not hold back the hour shown
network_quiet_hours.change: the default argument of completeHour in site/lib/networkV3.ts

network_hour_shown.value: the newest hour every reporting pair holds
network_hour_shown.source: site/lib/networkV3.ts completeHour and site/lib/gridKeys.ts shownHour; the newest hour of all when no hour is whole

network_sign.source: site/lib/gridKeys.ts tiesOf and site/lib/network.ts netValue: a tie's flow is signed from the grid's side; net export is the sum over its reporting ties, net import the same sum from the other side

network_top_exporter_tie.source: site/lib/network.ts topExporter: of equal net exports, the balancing authority whose code sorts first

network_lag_rounding.source: site/lib/network.ts netValue, net|lag: the hours from the hour shown to the snapshot's refresh, by JavaScript's Math.round

gravity_source.value: EIA-930 net generation for every circle, CAISO's included
gravity_source.source: the owner's ruling 1a of 18 October 2026 (docs/methods/grid_network.md, "One page, four tabs, and the Ask panel"); the line under the frame names California's break of December 2025

gravity_pull.value: sign(share) x sqrt(|share| / 0.25), held to one
gravity_pull.source: the owner's ruling 2c of 18 October 2026; site/lib/networkGravity.ts
gravity_pull.change: site/lib/networkGravity.ts GRAVITY.S_FULL and the pull's formula

gravity_full_pull_share.unit: share of the grid's net generation

gravity_others.value: the 63 other balancing authorities are not drawn
gravity_others.source: the owner's ruling 6a of 18 October 2026: their net generation is not in the live set; the line under the frame counts them

grid_opening.source: the owner's ruling 4b of 18 October 2026; site/lib/gridtool.ts gridPick

carbon_intensity.value: CO2 generated x 1,000 over net generation
carbon_intensity.source: warehouse/derived/carbon_intensity.py; docs/methods/emissions.md: EIA's CO2 Emissions Generated over the Net generation column of the same EIA-930 workbook row

carbon_daily_monthly.value: energy-weighted over whole UTC days and months
carbon_daily_monthly.source: docs/methods/emissions.md: a day is its CO2 over its MWh over UTC days with all 24 hours; a month the same over months whose every day is complete

carbon_left_out.value: months computed on an impossible hour, and California's months without hydro, are not shown
carbon_left_out.source: site/data/carbon_left_out.json (warehouse/derived/carbon_left_out.py, docs/methods/impossible_hours.md); held until a person approves the rebuilt table
carbon_left_out.change: a person's approval of the rebuilt carbon tables

mix_latest_hour.value: the latest hour that holds the total net generation
mix_latest_hour.source: components/grid/NowView.tsx: its sources largest first; demand's latest hour and the same hour a week earlier

mix_caiso.value: EIA-930's generation for California is not drawn; CAISO's own supply from 2025-12-16
mix_caiso.source: components/grid/NowView.tsx (session 118) and docs/methods/eia930_caiso_break.md (the one join of the warehouse)

mix_sources.value: natural gas, coal, nuclear, wind, solar, hydro, storage, other
mix_sources.source: docs/methods/generation_mix_hourly.md, "The sources": EIA's codes grouped as the site groups them

ask_examples_per_grid.source: site/data/grid_ask_examples.json max_examples: answers a recorded evaluation graded right, each figure traced to its tool result

ask_scope.value: a grid's own chat and the Grid panel's profile read only that grid's rows
ask_scope.source: warehouse/chat/tools.py scope_rows with docs/grids/grids.json and docs/grids/grid_tables.json; the general chat reads every row

license_held_grids.source: site/data/license_status.json, read by site/lib/license.ts on 6 November 2026 (from 21 October 2026): a figure of a table held for a grid prints "license needed"
license_held_grids.change: a publisher's permission recorded in site/data/license_status.json

tolerance.value: half of the last digit the page shows
tolerance.source: site/lib/format.ts shown(): a whole number as a count, any other with two decimals; a stored answer's figure as its text has it
